description: This file defines the interface IManagementGrain for system management functions in Orleans, a distributed virtual actor system. It includes methods for retrieving silo and grain statistics, performing maintenance tasks like garbage collection and activation collection, and controlling providers, among other administrative functions.

classes.name: GrainCallFrequency
classes.description: Represents an estimation of the frequency calls made from a source grain to a target grain.

methods.name: GetHosts
methods.description: Retrieves the list of silo hosts and their statuses in the cluster.

methods.name: GetDetailedHosts
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about silo hosts and membership, including statuses.

methods.name: ForceGarbageCollection
methods.description: Triggers garbage collection on specified silos.

methods.name: ForceActivationCollection
methods.description: Performs activation collection on specified silos with a given age limit.

methods.name: GetRuntimeStatistics
methods.description: Gets recent runtime statistics for specified silos.

methods.name: GetSimpleGrainStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves aggregated grain statistics across the cluster.

methods.name: GetDetailedGrainStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves detailed grain statistics, optionally filtered by types.

methods.name: GetGrainActivationCount
methods.description: Returns the activation count for a specific grain reference.

methods.name: GetTotalActivationCount
methods.description: Returns total grain activations across all silos.

methods.name: SendControlCommandToProvider
methods.description: Sends a control command to specified providers on all silos.

methods.name: GetActivationAddress
methods.description: Finds the silo address where a specific grain is activated.

methods.name: GetActiveGrains
methods.description: Returns all active grain IDs for a specific grain type.

methods.name: GetGrainCallFrequencies
methods.description: Estimates grain call frequencies from specified hosts.

methods.name: ResetGrainCallFrequencies
methods.description: Resets grain call frequency counts on specified hosts.
